provenance: 父流程 dump 的独立只读审计，不是本轮重搜。原文件按字节纳入 audit/independent-search-execution-audit-2026-11-20.json。
tool_args_limitation: All 124 web_search records in this dump lack tool_args on both the assistant tool_calls and the tool result lines. The exact query string sent to the tool therefore cannot be byte-verified from this file. select.query in the r2 package is an assistant-written field, not a recovered tool argument. Correspondence below is by URL (and, for one Wikisource path, the same URL inside the result chunk).
select_query_status: select.query 只是包内计划字段。原 dump 没有 tool_args，不能把它当成已核验的发送参数。本文件不补造查询字符串。
